notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 — First Week Update
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who bought the game, supported us, left reviews, and talked about Whimside on social media. It’s been a wild launch week full of amazing releases, and we’re proud to be part of this wholesome community. Your kind words keep us making games![/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][h2][/h2][h3][b]☁️ Cloud Saves[/b][/h3][p]Whimside now supports Cloud Saves on Windows and SteamOS. We’ve tested on Windows; Steam Deck is untested so far. If you run into any issues, please let us know on Discord.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎯 Custom Targets[/b][/h3][p]Track specific Whimlings and set your own objectives. Click the small target icon in the top-right corner.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💎 Real automatic collector[/b][/h3][p]Now, the automatic collector upgrade is truly automatic! No need to press a button to gather crystals. [/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]New & Improved[/h3][list][*][p]Added Cloud Saves support[/p][/*][*][p]Create your own Target Whimlings[/p][/*][*][p]Toadz’s position is now remembered[/p][/*][*][p]The automatic collector is now truly automatic—no button press needed[/p][/*][*][p]Press [b]F12[/b] to take screenshots (uses the game’s built-in capture, not Steam’s screenshot library)[/p][/*][*][p]Various localization updates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Buttons now highlight correctly when the tutorial asks you to click them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a launch-time issue that could prevent the game from starting
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks everyone,[/p][p]Toadzillart & Tadpoly ♥[/p]

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
[p]Hey all,

We hope you’ve been enjoying the demo so far! We’re writing to you today to update you on some changes we’ve made to it, to make gameplay even better for you all.

[b]New Languages Added:[/b] 🌍We have added the following languages so that more of our friends around the world can enjoy Whimside!  English, French, PT-BR, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese & Russian![/p][p][/p][p] [b]New Decorations to make yourself at home:[/b]
🏴‍☠️Pirate set- the whimlings are of course the real treasure!
🏖️ Beach set and ground- let your whimlings relax and sunbathe!
🌴Cove nature set- add palm trees to give it that tropical feel!

[b]Content Update:[/b]
🪑Workbench: centralize unlocks (new enclosure, garden expand, automatic collector)
💎Automatic crystal collect button can be purchased at Workbench
🌿Garden can be expanded (we recommend starting small)

[b]Twitch mode update:[/b]
♥️New animation for love command: hovering heart!
✋Follow boost now last 5 minutes (from 30 sec)
🕙Sub boost now last 10 minutes (from 1 minute)

[b]QOL Updates:[/b]
♊You can now sort Whimlings by duplicates
🔙Quick deletion - you can now delete Whimling by batch
🪟The last filter in the breeding panel and the menu windows’s positions are saved

Also, note that save will reset with this update, but will carry on to the full game ☺️

We hope you enjoy these updates and continue to have fun with our lil whimlings! Be sure to wishlist the game and stay tuned for more updates!

- Toadzillart & Tadpoly
[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the whimsical world of WHIMSIDE!
notes.content:
Hey there,

[h2]Welcome to the whimsical world of WHIMSIDE![/h2]

[previewyoutube=Gk7SZDl9BF4;full]
INSERT TRAILER[/previewyoutube]

We’re so excited to be officially announcing our debut game, an idle creature collection game that sits at the bottom of your screen, where you capture and create new species of Whimlings who keep you company as you work, browse or play on your computer! If you like Pokemon & Rusty’s Retirement, we think you’ll love WHIMSIDE! ☺️

[h2]A little about us ✨[/h2]
We’re Toadzillart and Tadpoly, a couple based in France 🥐
We have two fur baby whimlings, Oscar the black cat and Tigri the tabby 🐈
We first met on Animal Crossing where we started dating virtually, star gazing and playing hide and seek on our islands! 💘

We work on every project together, but this is our first ever game! With our respective experiences as a Backend Python Developer and a Tabletop RPG Writer, we both bring our strengths to the work 🎮

We’ll leave you to check out the demo which is now LIVE, we hope you love it as much as we do! Be sure to wishlist our game to keep notified on future updates 💌 You can also follow us for more WHIMSIDE content on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@whimside_cozy_game]Tiktok [/url] & [url=https://x.com/Toadzillart]Twitter (X)[/url].

- Toadzillart & Tadpoly

notes.title: Devlog #01: Enhancements and Accessibility in Whimside
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Whimside Developer Logs![/h2]

In these logs, I'll share the latest updates, insights, and behind-the-scenes looks at the development of Whimside. Whether you're a long-time player or new to our community, these logs are your window into the evolution of the game and an opportunity to see how your feedback helps shape our journey. Let's dive into the latest enhancements and improvements!

[h2]Enhancing Whimling Ownership[/h2]

In our initial alpha release, we noticed that collecting Whimlings wasn't as engaging as we had hoped. While our upcoming achievement and collection feature promises to add more depth to this aspect, I've taken your feedback to heart and agree that we missed a crucial element of the collecting experience—forming a bond with these adorable creatures.

To address this, I'm excited to introduce several new features that will deepen your connection with your Whimlings:
[list]
[*] Renaming: Personalize your Whimlings by giving them names.
[*] Favoriting: Mark your favorite Whimlings to easily find and interact with them.
[*] Locking: Secure your cherished Whimlings against accidental deletion.
[*] Petting: Interact with your Whimlings in your garden to increase their affection.
[*] Crystal Production: Removed the Generator Wheel. Now, Whimlings in your garden will produce Crystals, with the output influenced by their rarity and affection level.
[*] These updates aim to make each Whimling feel more like a personal companion, enhancing the joy and satisfaction of collecting.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075235/34fe20ae129151bd2ee5efe8079232a9dddf92bf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075235/913da7894c6de62e12b09b851bd3c11949c1d1c1.gif[/img]

[h2]Advancing Accessibility[/h2]

We've also made significant strides in improving game accessibility:
Font Update: We've transitioned from a pixel art font to Noto Sans. This change not only improves readability but also supports multiple languages, facilitating easier game localization.
Enhanced Tooltips: Continuous improvements in tooltips are being implemented to provide clearer guidance throughout the game.
While I may consider reintroducing pixel fonts as an alternative in the future, our primary focus remains on ensuring that the game is accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
Special thanks to Artie for their valuable insights on accessibility issues in Whimside, and for providing resources that have greatly aided our efforts to enhance accessibility throughout the game.

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/CdMEzy3w]Join Us on Discord![/url][/h2]

Want to be more involved in shaping the future of Whimside? Join our Discord community! It's a great place to discuss the game, meet fellow enthusiasts, and participate in future alpha tests. We value your input and look forward to seeing you there!
